Home/The Firm

THE FIRM

Experience informed by investigation.
Representation grounded in law.

R.K. Puri Law is a Jodhpur-based legal practice focused on criminal law, litigation, and related legal proceedings.

THE PRACTICE

Experience. Insight. Advocacy.

R.K. Puri Law is a Jodhpur-based, multidisciplinary litigation practice with a strong foundation in criminal law, criminal investigations, and courtroom advocacy.

Led by Rakesh Puri, a retired Additional Superintendent of Police with 35 years of distinguished police service and 11 years of criminal law practice, the firm brings together extensive investigative experience and practical legal knowledge.

The firm's approach is informed by a thorough understanding of criminal investigations, evidentiary procedures, trial preparation, and the complexities of judicial proceedings. This distinctive background enables the legal team to examine matters from both investigative and legal perspectives, developing strategies grounded in facts, evidence, and applicable law.

Multidisciplinary Litigation Capability

Supported by a team of associate advocates with experience across criminal, civil, constitutional, commercial, and regulatory law, R.K. Puri Law provides representation in a broad spectrum of legal proceedings.

The firm's practice extends to the Rajasthan High Court, District and Sessions Courts, Magistrate Courts, and specialised judicial forums, including courts dealing with NDPS, POCSO, anti-corruption, and other criminal matters.

Our Approach

At R.K. Puri Law, every matter is approached with careful legal analysis, attention to procedural detail, and a commitment to professional integrity. The firm emphasises thorough preparation, clear communication, and representation tailored to the individual circumstances of each case.

/investigation-expertise/.content:
Home/Investigation Expertise

SPECIALIZED CAPABILITY

Criminal Investigation Advisory & Evidence

A distinctive perspective bridging criminal investigation leadership with courtroom trial advocacy.

FIELD EXPERIENCE

5,000+ Investigations Handled & Supervised

A criminal case is largely won or lost during the investigation stage. A sound understanding of investigative procedure is crucial when assessing criminal allegations, evaluating evidence, identifying procedural irregularities, and preparing a robust legal defence.

During his 35-year police career culminating as Additional Superintendent of Police, Rakesh Puri personally investigated and supervised more than 5,000 cases. His experience encompasses murder, kidnapping, forgery, crimes against women, economic crime, and complex Indian Penal Code offences, as well as specialized operational work with JDVVNL and the Anti-Terrorist Squad (ATS), Jodhpur.

What Our Investigation Advisory Delivers

  • Scrutiny of Police Records: In-depth examination of First Information Reports (FIRs), daily general diaries, arrest memos, search and seizure rosters, and site plans.
  • Evidentiary Vulnerabilities: Identifying breaks in the chain of custody, delayed recording of witness statements, and procedural breaches under CrPC/BNSS.
  • Forensics & Medical Jurisprudence: Expert evaluation of post-mortem reports, medico-legal certificates (MLCs), ballistic reports, DNA analysis, and chemical examination reports.
  • Electronic & Digital Evidence: Scrutinizing CDRs (Call Detail Records), tower location data, CCTV footage, mobile extractions, and compliance with certification mandates.
  • Witness Impeachment Strategy: Formulating precise cross-examination lines to reveal tutoring, contradictions, and material omissions.
  • Advisory for Fellow Advocates: Confidential collaboration with trial lawyers seeking specialized investigative analysis of complex case files.
Consult on Investigation Records ↗

Home/Practice Areas/Criminal Law

PRACTICE AREA

Criminal Litigation & Defence

Criminal defence, trial proceedings, bail applications, and appellate remedies before Sessions Courts and the Rajasthan High Court.

APPROACH & EXPERIENCE

Investigation-Informed Courtroom Defence

R.K. Puri Law handles criminal proceedings at every stage of the criminal justice process—from pre-charge investigation scrutiny and remand proceedings to trial defence, bail applications, appeals, and revision petitions.

Drawing on Rakesh Puri's 35 years of senior police service and 11 years of criminal legal practice, the firm brings unmatched practical insight into the realities of criminal investigation. This enables the legal team to detect flaws in police procedures, scrutinize case diaries, challenge tainted seizure memos, and formulate compelling trial defence strategies.

Scope of Criminal Practice

  • Trial Advocacy: Defence representation across the Court of Sessions, Chief Judicial Magistrate, and Judicial Magistrate First Class courts.
  • Bail & Liberty: Pre-trial bail, regular bail, anticipatory bail, and interim protection before Sessions and High Court benches.
  • Charge-Sheet Scrutiny: Exhaustive review of police reports, statements under Section 161/164, and evidence exhibits.
  • Discharge Applications: Seeking discharge of accused where allegations are malicious or prima facie unsustainable.
  • Cross-Examination: Skillful cross-examination of eyewitnesses, investigating officers, and medical/forensic experts.
  • Criminal Appeals & Revisions: Challenging convictions, sentences, or irregular interlocutory orders before appellate courts.
  • Special Criminal Statutes: Representation in NDPS, POCSO, Anti-Corruption (PC Act), SC/ST (POA) Act, and CBI matters.

/practice-areas/writ-jurisdiction/.content:
Home/Practice Areas/Writ Jurisdiction

PRACTICE AREA

Writ Petitions & Constitutional Remedies

Writ proceedings under Articles 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India before the High Court of Judicature for Rajasthan.

HIGH COURT JURISDICTION

Remedies Against Arbitrary State Action

R.K. Puri Law handles writ petitions and constitutional proceedings before the Rajasthan High Court at Jodhpur and Jaipur. Writ jurisdiction provides extraordinary legal remedies where fundamental rights or statutory duties have been infringed by public authorities, administrative bodies, or subordinate tribunals.

Led by Rakesh Puri with associate advocate Lucky Singh focusing on writ drafting and constitutional jurisprudence, the firm prepares meticulously grounded petitions supported by documentary proof and binding legal precedents.

Prerogative Writs Handled

  • Habeas Corpus: For the production of persons unlawfully detained or missing in police custody or unauthorized confinement.
  • Mandamus: Compelling statutory authorities and government officials to perform their mandatory legal duties.
  • Certiorari: Quashing illegal, unconstitutional, or jurisdictionally defective orders passed by administrative bodies or lower forums.
  • Prohibition: Restraining subordinate judicial or quasi-judicial bodies from exceeding their lawful jurisdiction.
  • Quo Warranto: Challenging the legal authority or eligibility of an individual holding a public office.
  • Criminal Writs & Quashing: Petitions under Article 226 / Section 482 for quashing malicious FIRs, protecting personal liberty, and ensuring fair investigation.

LEGAL INFORMATION

Privacy policy.

How the Firm handles personal information received through this website.

RK Puri Law | Rakesh Puri & Associates

Effective Date: 10 November 2026
Last Updated: 10 November 2026

1. Introduction

RK Puri Law, operating under the name Rakesh Puri & Associates ("Firm", "we", "us" or "our"), is committed to respecting and protecting the privacy of individuals who access or use its website, www.rkpurilaw.com ("Website").

This Privacy Policy explains how the Firm may collect, receive, use, store, disclose and otherwise process personal information in connection with access to the Website and communications initiated through it.

The Firm’s principal office is situated in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India, and its professional activities are conducted within India.

This Policy is intended to operate in accordance with applicable Indian laws relating to information technology, data protection and privacy, including the Information Technology Act, 2000, the applicable rules framed thereunder and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and rules made thereunder, to the extent applicable and in force.

2. Scope of this Policy

This Policy applies to personal information collected through:

  • Access to and use of the Website;
  • Emails and other electronic communications addressed to the Firm;
  • Contact or enquiry forms made available on the Website;
  • Communications concerning the Firm’s professional services; and
  • Other interactions with the Firm in connection with the Website.

This Policy does not replace any separate confidentiality obligations, professional duties or arrangements applicable to an advocate–client relationship or an existing legal engagement.

3. Information We May Collect

Depending on the nature of your interaction with the Website, the Firm may collect or receive the following categories of information:

3.1 Personal Identification Information

Information voluntarily provided by you, which may include:

  • Name;
  • Email address;
  • Telephone or mobile number;
  • Postal address; and
  • Professional or organisational details.

3.2 Information Provided Through Communications

Where you communicate with the Firm, you may voluntarily provide information relating to a legal enquiry or other matter.

Such information may include descriptions of legal issues, relevant factual particulars, documents or other material supplied by you.

Please do not submit confidential case papers, identity documents, financial records or other sensitive information through an unsecured website form. Any such information should be transmitted only through an appropriate channel specifically authorised by the Firm.

3.3 Technical and Usage Information

When you access the Website, certain technical information may be collected automatically, depending on the Website’s configuration. This may include:

  • Internet Protocol (IP) address;
  • Browser type and version;
  • Device and operating system information;
  • Date and time of access;
  • Pages visited and general browsing activity; and
  • Referring website or source.

Such information may be used for website administration, security, troubleshooting and performance analysis.

3.4 Contact Form and Messaging

When you submit the enquiry form on the Website, the details you enter (name, telephone number, email address if provided, enquiry type, matter category and message) are transmitted to the Firm’s website service provider for the purpose of recording and forwarding your enquiry to the Firm. The Website then opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message containing the same details. Whether you send that message is your choice. WhatsApp processes information under its own terms and privacy policy, which the Firm does not control.

4. Purpose of Collection and Use

Information collected by the Firm may be used for the following purposes, as applicable:

  • To operate, maintain and administer the Website;
  • To respond to communications initiated by visitors;
  • To understand and address enquiries received by the Firm;
  • To maintain records of communications;
  • To protect the security and integrity of the Website;
  • To identify and address technical issues;
  • To comply with applicable legal and professional obligations; and
  • To establish, exercise or defend legal rights and claims, where necessary.

The Firm will seek to ensure that information is used only for purposes that are lawful and reasonably connected with the relevant interaction.

5. Disclosure and Sharing of Information

The Firm does not intend to sell personal information collected through the Website.

Information may be disclosed or made available in the following circumstances, where lawful and necessary:

5.1 Service Providers

The Firm may use third-party service providers for website hosting, email services, technical maintenance, security and other operational functions.

Such providers may process information on behalf of the Firm to the extent necessary for providing the relevant services.

These may include the Firm’s website technology provider, which receives and stores enquiries submitted through the contact form, and WhatsApp.

5.2 Legal and Regulatory Requirements

Information may be disclosed where required by applicable law, a competent court, statutory authority or other lawful process.

5.3 Protection of Legal Rights

Information may be used or disclosed where reasonably necessary to establish, exercise or defend legal rights, subject to applicable law and professional confidentiality obligations.

5.4 Professional Confidentiality

Nothing in this Policy is intended to waive or dilute any applicable duty of professional confidentiality or privilege.

Information relating to a professional engagement will be handled subject to the applicable legal and ethical obligations governing advocates.

6. Cookies and Similar Technologies

The Website may use cookies or similar technologies to support its functioning, improve usability and understand general website traffic.

Cookies are small data files that may be stored on a visitor’s device.

Depending on the Website’s configuration, these technologies may be used for:

  • Essential website functionality;
  • Security and session management;
  • Website performance; and
  • General traffic analysis.

Visitors may manage or disable cookies through their browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect some Website functionalities.

Where required by applicable law, the Firm will obtain appropriate consent before using non-essential tracking technologies.

7. Data Storage and Retention

The Firm will retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, or for such period as may be required under applicable law, professional obligations or legitimate record-keeping requirements.

The applicable retention period may depend upon:

  • The nature of the information;
  • The purpose for which it was collected;
  • Whether the information relates to a professional engagement;
  • Applicable legal and regulatory requirements; and
  • The need to establish or defend legal rights.

Upon expiry of the applicable retention period, information may be deleted, anonymised or otherwise disposed of through appropriate means, subject to applicable legal and professional obligations.

8. Information Security

The Firm takes reasonable measures, appropriate to the nature of the information and the Website’s operations, to protect personal information against unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, misuse or destruction.

Such measures may include appropriate access controls, password protection, secure communication channels, website security measures and reasonable technical safeguards.

However, no method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Visitors are advised not to transmit confidential or sensitive information through public or unsecured communication channels.

9. Third-Party Websites

The Website may contain links to external websites or resources operated by third parties.

The Firm does not control the privacy practices, security measures or content of such external websites.

Accessing any third-party website is at the visitor’s discretion, and visitors are encouraged to review the privacy policies applicable to those websites.

10. Rights and Choices of Individuals

Subject to applicable law and its commencement, individuals may have rights concerning their personal information, including rights to:

  • Obtain information regarding the processing of their personal data;
  • Request correction or updating of inaccurate or incomplete information;
  • Request erasure of personal data, where legally permissible;
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent;
  • Raise grievances concerning the processing of personal information; and
  • Exercise other rights available under applicable data protection laws.

Requests concerning personal information may be submitted using the contact details provided below.

The Firm may require reasonable verification of the identity of the person making such a request before acting upon it.

Nothing in this Policy shall require the Firm to delete or disclose information where retention or non-disclosure is required or permitted under applicable law, professional obligations or legal privilege.

11. Children’s Information

The Website is not intended to knowingly collect personal information from children except where such collection is lawful and accompanied by the authorisation or other safeguards required under applicable law.

Where personal information relating to a child is received inadvertently, the Firm may take appropriate steps in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

12. Changes to this Privacy Policy

The Firm reserves the right to revise or update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in applicable laws, regulatory requirements, technology or Website operations.

The updated version will be published on the Website with the revised date.

Visitors are encouraged to review this Policy periodically.

Any access to the Website is undertaken voluntarily and at the initiative of the visitor.

TEAM

Meet the Team

Meet the advocates and legal team of R.K. Puri Law / Rakesh Puri & Associates in Jodhpur, Rajasthan.

FOUNDER & PRINCIPAL COUNSEL

Rakesh Kumar Puri

Advocate · Retired Additional Superintendent of Police · B.Com., LL.B.

The practice of R.K. Puri Law is shaped by the professional experience of Rakesh Kumar Puri, whose career spans 35 years of police service and 11 years of criminal law practice. Enrolled with the Bar Council of Rajasthan in 2016 and holding his B.Com. LL.B. from Jai Narayan Vyas University, Jodhpur (1979), his practice focuses on criminal litigation, trial advocacy, investigation advisory, and constitutional writ matters before the Rajasthan High Court.

During his policing career, he served as Station House Officer (SHO) and Circle Officer in various districts of Rajasthan, as Additional Superintendent of Police with JDVVNL in Jodhpur, and as Additional Superintendent of Police with the Anti-Terrorist Squad (ATS), Jodhpur. Over 5,000 cases were investigated and supervised during his police tenure, earning him more than 300 commendation certificates and awards.

Read full professional profile LinkedIn Profile ↗

ASSOCIATE ADVOCATES

Multidisciplinary Associate Team

At R.K. Puri Law, foundational investigative experience is supported by associate advocates working across multiple areas of litigation.

Bhagirath Singh

Advocate · 8 Years Legal Experience

Bhagirath Singh is an advocate with eight years of experience in civil and criminal trial advocacy, including criminal matters before the Rajasthan High Court. His practice encompasses family law, narcotics-related offences under the NDPS Act, consumer protection, negotiable instruments, revenue law, and municipal law. He handles litigation involving procedural, evidentiary, and substantive legal issues, with an emphasis on careful case preparation and effective representation before relevant courts and tribunals.

Advocate · 5 Years Legal Experience

Vikram Chaudhary has five years of legal experience, with a practice encompassing MSME-related disputes, banking law, cyber law, and criminal litigation. His areas of work involve legal issues arising from commercial transactions, financial disputes, technology-related offences, and criminal proceedings. He contributes to the firm's multidisciplinary litigation practice through legal research, case preparation, advisory work, and representation in matters falling within his areas of practice.

Advocate · 3 Years Legal Experience

Lucky Singh has three years of legal experience, with a focus on writ petitions, criminal appeals, corporate law, and intellectual property rights (IPR). His practice includes constitutional and appellate proceedings, corporate legal matters, and disputes concerning intellectual property. He assists in legal research, drafting, case preparation, and litigation strategy, contributing to the firm's work across public law, criminal appellate matters, and commercial legal issues.

REGULATORY COMPLIANCE

Non-Solicitation Policy

Compliance with the Bar Council of India Rules under the Advocates Act, 1961.

Statutory Declaration under Rule 36 of the Bar Council of India Rules

Under Rule 36, Section IV, Chapter II, Part VI of the Bar Council of India Rules, Indian advocates and law firms are strictly prohibited from soliciting work or advertising their professional services in any form, direct or indirect.

1. Informational Purpose Only

This website (rkpurilaw.com) is operated solely for the purpose of providing general information regarding the professional background, areas of practice, and team credentials of R.K. Puri Law / Rakesh Puri & Associates. None of the material on this website constitutes legal advice, advertisement, personal communication, solicitation, invitation, or inducement of any sort whatsoever.

2. Voluntary User Access

By accessing this website, the user confirms that:

  • The user is seeking information about R.K. Puri Law of their own accord and volition.
  • There has been no form of solicitation, advertisement, or inducement by R.K. Puri Law or its members.
  • The contents of this website are accessed purely for informational and educational purposes.

3. Absence of Advocate–Client Relationship

Transmission, receipt, or use of this website or sending an enquiry through our contact forms or WhatsApp integration does not create an advocate-client relationship. A formal advocate-client relationship is created exclusively through a written engagement letter, formal vakalatnama, and agreed terms after conflict checks.

4. Consultation Rates & Fee Inquiries

In accordance with Bar Council ethical standards, fees and consultation rates are never published as promotional rates. Consultation fees are confirmed privately upon understanding the scope, documentation, and specific jurisdiction of the matter.

5. Conflict of Interest Checks

Before accepting any brief or entering into professional consultation, R.K. Puri Law conducts mandatory conflict-of-interest checks to ensure adherence to professional ethics.

6. Contact for Verification

If you require information regarding our practice or wish to clarify the scope of our services, you may contact chambers at:

Home/Founder

FOUNDER PROFILE

Rakesh Kumar Puri

Advocate | Retired Additional Superintendent of Police. 35 years in police service and 11 years of criminal legal practice in Rajasthan.

Rakesh Kumar Puri Advocate · Retired Additional SP Connect on LinkedIn ↗

BIOGRAPHY & PROFESSIONAL JOURNEY

Decades in the Field. Applied in the Courtroom.

Rakesh Kumar Puri is a retired Additional Superintendent of Police with over 35 years of distinguished experience in policing, criminal investigation, and law enforcement. His extensive service, spanning the rank of Inspector of Police to Additional Superintendent of Police, has equipped him with exceptional practical knowledge of criminal investigations, evidence gathering, and the conduct of criminal trials.

During his police career, he served as Station House Officer (SHO) and Circle Officer in various districts of Rajasthan, as Additional Superintendent of Police with JDVVNL in Jodhpur, and as Additional Superintendent of Police with the Anti-Terrorist Squad (ATS), Jodhpur. Over 5,000 cases were investigated and supervised under his leadership, spanning murder, kidnapping, forgery, crimes against women, economic crime, and complex Indian Penal Code offences.

His exceptional service was recognized with more than 300 commendation certificates and commendation certificates with cash awards. During his service, he also delivered lectures on forensics, medical jurisprudence, women safety, and police administration, and attended multiple capsule trainings in the criminal justice system.

Legal Practice & High Court Advocacy

Graduating with a B.Com. LL.B. from Jai Narayan Vyas University, Jodhpur in 1979 and enrolled with the Bar Council of Rajasthan in 2016, he has over 11 years of dedicated criminal legal practice. Practising before the Rajasthan High Court (Criminal Benches, Writ Benches) and District & Sessions Courts, he handles criminal trials, appeals, revisions, quashing petitions, and writ litigation.

Combining decades of field experience with substantial legal expertise, he offers a distinctive perspective that bridges the gap between criminal investigation and courtroom advocacy. He also leads a dedicated team of associate advocates handling civil, commercial, banking, cyber, and regulatory matters.

CORE TRIAL & LITIGATION SKILLS

Mastery Across Every Stage of Trial

01

Case Theory Formulation

Strategic formulation of defence or prosecution theory grounded in the statutory elements and factual record.

02

Charge Sheet Scrutiny

Microscopic analysis of investigation diaries, 161 statements, seizure memos, and procedural non-compliance.

03

Expert Cross-Examination

Rigorous cross-examination of forensic experts, ballistic analysts, and medical doctors on post-mortem and injury reports.

04

Electronic Evidence

Handling and challenging electronic evidence under Section 65B of the Evidence Act / BSA provisions and cyber data.

05

Witness Credibility

Impeaching witness credibility through prior contradictory statements, procedural flaws, and circumstantial inconsistencies.

06

Bail Advocacy

High-calibre advocacy in pre-trial bail, regular bail, and anticipatory bail across standard and stringent special enactments.

07

Discharge & Framing Arguments

Arguments on discharge under CrPC/BNSS before charge framing where allegations lack prima facie foundation.

08

Evidence Marshalling

Final arguments that synthesize evidentiary exhibits, forensic doubts, and binding High Court and Supreme Court precedents.

CHRONOLOGY

Milestones of Service and Practice

1979

B.Com., LL.B. Degree

Graduated in commerce and law from Jai Narayan Vyas University, Jodhpur, establishing an enduring academic grounding in law.

35 YRS

Distinguished Rajasthan Police Service

Service from Inspector of Police to Additional Superintendent of Police. SHO and Circle Officer postings across Rajasthan districts.

POSTINGS

Addl. SP JDVVNL & Addl. SP ATS Jodhpur

Specialized executive leadership in power distribution enforcement and Anti-Terrorist Squad operational investigations.

5,000+

Investigations Handled & Supervised

Major investigations in murder, kidnapping, forgery, crimes against women, and financial offences; over 300 commendation awards.

2016

Bar Council Enrolment

Enrolled with the Bar Council of Rajasthan, initiating high-level criminal litigation and trial practice.

PRESENT

Founder, R.K. Puri Law & High Court Practitioner

Over 11 years of criminal legal practice, advising individuals, fellow advocates, and organisations before the High Court and Sessions Courts.
